Event/Horizon
Event/Horizon explores the limitless hunger for the calculation of “future” —
future-price, future-crime, future-climate, future-use, future-wish, and so on —
within an epoch supposedly marked by the impossibility of scientific forecasts.
Taking place in Turrell’s Celestial Vault, the sky collapses onto the earth: a negative
space, blind to Mercator’s projection, in which vectors lose their capacity for
territorial navigation. Within this off-shore vault, students hallucinate models for
investment, cast pictorial, anachronistic divinations and render scientific models
into vessels for cheerful superstition.

Education: Seminars: All watched over by machines of loving grace
All watched over by machines of loving grace
Quantification and the algorithmic processes associated with it are the central
characteristic of an increasingly technically mediated time. At the same time,
the technology of a society is closely linked to its specific models of power. We
approached technologies that raised the previous development of algorithmic
thinking to a new level: “Artificial Intelligence”. We dealt with parallel developments of
“(historical) museology” and “artificial intelligence”. How do both developments shape
our culture? How do the developments present themselves visually? And how do they
intersect?
Kunsthochschule Weißensee, Rijksmuseum Amsterdam
